name: Voice Ops Settings
description: Configuration for Voice Ops integrations and call settings

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Configure credentials in Twilio Settings or Exotel Settings based on selected providers

fields.label: Telephony Providers
fields.description: Configure providers independently for outbound (checklist calls to drivers) and inbound (driver query calls)

fields.label: Outbound Provider
fields.description: Provider for outbound checklist calls (pre-departure, post-trip)

fields.label: Inbound Provider
fields.description: Provider for inbound driver query calls

fields.label: Exophone (Virtual Number)
fields.description: Exotel virtual number used for outbound calls (e.g. 08037091588)

fields.label: Caller ID
fields.description: Caller ID shown to the recipient. Usually same as exophone.

fields.label: Outbound Flow App ID
fields.description: Exotel App (Flow) ID for outbound Passthru (e.g. 1223268). If set, outbound uses App=<id>; otherwise falls back to dynamic Url passthru.

fields.label: Feedback Flow App ID
fields.description: Exotel App (Flow) ID for outbound feedback calls. Build a static flow in the Exotel App Builder: Greeting -> Record -> Hangup. Leave blank to use dynamic ExoML (Feedback Prompt Audio URL) instead.

fields.label: Feedback Prompt Audio URL
fields.description: Publicly reachable URL (HTTPS MP3 or WAV) played to the driver on a feedback call when using the ExoML path. Used only when Feedback Flow App ID is blank. Leave blank to fall back to Hindi TTS.

fields.label: Call Buffer (minutes before departure)
fields.description: How many minutes before scheduled departure to trigger the checklist call

fields.label: Default Pre-Departure Template
fields.description: Template used for auto-triggered pre-departure calls

fields.label: Max Recording Length (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum duration for a single answer recording. Hard cap regardless of silence.

fields.label: Default Response Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds of silence before moving to the next question. Can be overridden per question.

fields.label: Default Post-Trip Template
fields.description: Template used for auto-triggered post-arrival calls. Leave blank to disable post-trip calls.

fields.label: Post-Trip Buffer (minutes after completion)
fields.description: How many minutes after trip completion to allow triggering the post-trip call

fields.label: Post-Trip Feedback
fields.description: Auto-trigger a feedback call to driver_1 a fixed number of minutes after the Trip Roster Assignment's scheduled departure time (from the linked Schedule Addition). Uses the feedback flow configured in the General tab.

fields.label: Enable Feedback Auto Call
fields.description: When on, the scheduler checks every 5 minutes and triggers one feedback call per eligible Trip Roster Assignment.

fields.label: Feedback Buffer (minutes after scheduled time)
fields.description: Trigger the feedback call this many minutes after the scheduled departure time. E.g. 30 = call at 6:30pm for a 6:00pm departure.

fields.label: Enable Inbound Calls
fields.description: Allow drivers to call in with queries. Configure the inbound number in your telephony provider's dashboard.

fields.label: Inbound Greeting Language
fields.description: Fallback language for IVR prompts (callers choose via DTMF)

fields.label: Max Query Recording (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum duration for the driver's free-speech query recording

fields.label: Sarvam Model
fields.description: saaras:v3 supports translate/transcribe modes. saarika:v2.5 is legacy (transcribe only).

fields.label: Sarvam Mode
fields.description: translate = any Indian language to English. transcribe = keep original language. verbatim = exact speech.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.options:
unknown
hi-IN
ta-IN
te-IN
kn-IN
en-IN
fields.description: Set to 'unknown' for auto-detection (recommended with saaras:v3)

fields.label: Anthropic API Key
fields.description: API key for Claude-based query summarization

fields.label: Low Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Transcripts below this confidence score will be flagged for review

fields.label: Enable Escalation Notifications
fields.description: Send in-app and email notifications when blockers or critical issues are detected

fields.label: Escalation Email Group
fields.description: Email Group to notify on escalations. Leave blank for in-app notifications only.

fields.label: Yes/No Synonyms
fields.description: Add language-specific words that mean Yes or No. These are merged with built-in defaults.

fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Notifications
fields.description: Send query notifications via WhatsApp (uses Twilio Messages API)

fields.label: Twilio WhatsApp Sender
fields.description: Twilio WhatsApp-enabled number (e.g. whatsapp:+14155238886). Used for query notifications and for driver / route-manager acks (via pre-approved Twilio Content Templates).

fields.label: Enable Email Notifications
fields.description: Send query notifications via email

fields.label: Reporter Phone (WhatsApp)
fields.description: Reporter's phone number with country code for WhatsApp notifications (e.g. +919876543210)

fields.label: Reporter Email
fields.description: Reporter's email address for query notifications

fields.label: Enable Voicemail Digest
fields.description: Send a daily digest of all voicemails received

fields.label: Digest Time
fields.description: Time of day to send the voicemail digest (server timezone)

fields.label: Digest Channel
fields.description: Notification channel for the voicemail digest

fields.label: Digest Email Recipients
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses for voicemail digest

fields.label: Digest WhatsApp Recipients
fields.description: Comma-separated phone numbers with country code (e.g. +919876543210)

fields.label: Email Route Manager on Issue
fields.description: Email the operations_incharge resolved from the caller's most recent Trip Roster Assignment. Silent when that person has no email on their Employee record.

fields.label: Acknowledge Driver on Issue (Email)
fields.description: Email the caller confirming the issue was logged. Silent when no email is resolvable from Contact / Employee records.

fields.label: Email Issue Alert Recipients on Issue
fields.description: Email the addresses listed in 'Issue Alert Email Recipients' every time a new Issue is created from a call. Silent when no recipients are configured.

fields.label: Default Driver Language
fields.description: Fallback BCP-47 code when Sarvam detection is unavailable (e.g. hi-IN, ta-IN, te-IN, kn-IN, en-IN).

fields.label: Issue Alert Email Recipients
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses that receive an alert every time a new Issue is created from a call (e.g. management, ops head).

fields.label: Exotel WhatsApp Acks
fields.description: Send WhatsApp acknowledgements via Exotel's WhatsApp Business API in addition to email. Templates must be pre-approved in the Exotel dashboard.

fields.label: Enable Exotel WhatsApp Acks
fields.description: Send driver and route manager acks over WhatsApp via Exotel. Uses credentials from Exotel Settings.

fields.label: Exotel WhatsApp Sender
fields.description: WhatsApp Business number registered with Exotel, in E.164 format (e.g. +919876543210).

fields.label: Template Language Code
fields.description: Language code registered on the Exotel template (e.g. en, en_US, hi).

fields.label: Driver Ack Template Name
fields.description: Pre-approved Exotel template for driver ack. Body parameters sent in order: {1} caller name, {2} issue name.

fields.label: Route Manager Alert Template Name
fields.description: Pre-approved Exotel template for route manager alert. Body parameters sent in order: {1} manager name, {2} issue name, {3} priority, {4} caller + phone, {5} vehicle, {6} issue URL.

fields.label: Driver Ack Templates By Language
fields.description: Map each detected caller language to the WhatsApp template to use when acknowledging the driver. Sarvam's detected language is matched against these rows; the Driver Ack Template Name above is used as fallback when no row matches.
